question: Meandrina is the generic name of which Coelenterata animal having soft tube-shaped bodies that live together in large groups?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brain coral.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Meandrina** is the generic name of **brain coral**, which belongs to the **Coelenterata phylum **of marine animals.
 
• Brain corals are **colonial animals** that have** tube-shaped bodies **with** ridges and valleys **on their surface, resembling the** folds of the human brain.**
 
• They are found in shallow tropical waters of the **Atlantic, Caribbean, and Indo-Pacific regions** and play a vital role in reef-building and ecosystem maintenance.
 
• Brain corals feed on **plankton and organic matter** through their **tentacles **and have a **symbiotic relationship with algae** that provide them with energy through photosynthesis.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sea anemones** (*Actiniaria*) are also **Coelenterata animals** with **tube-shaped bodies**, but they are** solitary** and have a more delicate structure with tentacles surrounding a central mouth.
 
• **Sea-fans*** (Gorgonia)* are a type of** coral with a fan-shaped structure,** while medusa is a** free-swimming jellyfish** with a bell-shaped body.
